messages.subject: Re: Installation problems via Skyline
parts:
The Skyline web site seems to have a bug in it where new versions of uploaded tools get put in a place that cannot be reached by anyone.

You can download the previous version of the MSstats tool (from June 2018) from here:
https://skyline.ms/skyts/home/software/Skyline/tools/details.view?name=MSstats&version=3.13.2

It looks like there was a new version of the MSstats tool that was uploaded today, and I cannot actually get to it. I will contact some other people on the Skyline team and get this fixed as soon as possible.
